root_idea.summary: The root centers on attentive care: holding something under regard so that it is not lost, damaged, neglected, or forgotten.
root_idea.development: From active watching and maintenance, the root develops meanings of protection, faithful observance, retention in memory, safekeeping and entrustment, and honor-based defensive anger. These related developments are not automatically meanings of every derived form.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested Form III verb with a persistent-observance construction.
Distinct Quran-attested Form X verb, represented under its normalized perfect citation form.
Active-participial Quran form displayed under the singular citation form.
Feminine plural active participle; merged with the corresponding active-participle citation form.

senses.definition: To preserve, protect, guard, or take careful charge of something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic uses include guarding people or things against harm or loss and protecting something entrusted to one's care.

senses.definition: To keep or observe an oath, including refraining from using it for trivial or improper purposes.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic usage in the command concerning oaths supports both faithful observance and restraint in the use of an oath.

senses.definition: To maintain, observe, or attend to something persistently and carefully.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran this construction is used especially of maintaining the prayers by observing their times, requirements, and performance with sustained care.

senses.definition: To charge or require someone to preserve, guard, or attend to something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic passive construction presents people as charged with preserving or maintaining what they received of the Book of God.

senses.definition: To entrust or place something with someone for safekeeping.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic passive may also be understood as being entrusted with the thing placed under one's care.

senses.definition: A keeper, guardian, or protector; one who watches over a person, thing, or charge.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran also uses the plural for guardians assigned to record human deeds and for people mindful of divinely prescribed duties.

senses.definition: One who guards the private parts, maintaining sexual chastity.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a Quranic euphemistic construction for preserving chastity; the wording applies to both masculine and feminine forms without making gender itself part of the lexical meaning.

senses.definition: One who faithfully keeps a marital trust or obligation during a spouse's absence.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction concerning the unseen, the emphasis is on observing the marital trust in the partner's absence through God's preserving care.

senses.definition: A guardian or protector; one who watches over something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses this adjective or noun for a guardian or protector, including in statements about responsibility over people.

senses.definition: Preserving or retaining something, as a record that keeps a person's deeds from being lost.
senses.usage_conditions: In the description of the record in Q 50:4, حفيظ may be understood actively as retaining or preserving the recorded deeds.
The same Quranic description of the record also admits a passive interpretation: it is safeguarded from disappearance or loss.

senses.definition: Guarding, protection, or preservation from harm or loss.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic verbal noun describes divine guarding of created things and protection from destructive influences.

senses.definition: Kept, preserved, or protected, especially from alteration, harm, or loss.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran applies the passive participle to something safeguarded from destructive interference or alteration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To retain something in the mind or memory; to remember or learn it by heart, including something heard from another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the cognitive-retention use of the Form I verb, distinct from physical guarding or preservation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep a secret.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional object construction for preserving confidential information.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep oneself or one's speech from base, trivial, or irrelevant use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This construction expresses restraint from using a person, one's tongue, or something else for mean or improper purposes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To regard and respect another's honor, inviolable rights, or claims to defense.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning concerns attentiveness to what is entitled to reverence or protection, rather than simple physical preservation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to commit a book, narration, or tradition to memory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II is causative: the subject induces another person to learn or retain material by heart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Defense of persons or things held sacred, inviolable, or worthy of honor, especially in circumstances of conflict; hence an honor-conscious or scornful stance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the honor-defense branch of the Form III verbal noun and related حِفَاظ terminology.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mindful observance of a covenant and fulfillment of a promise, with continued forgiveness and affection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional relational use of حِفَاظ distinct from the Quranic persistent observance of prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To anger someone, especially by foul or offensive speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV may describe causing anger by making someone hear what he dislikes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To guard oneself, become cautious, or remain watchful and heedful so as to avoid a slip or fault.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reflexive form expresses vigilance in affairs, speech, and conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To learn or retain a book by heart progressively, one part after another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a progressive memorization use, distinct from the general state of knowing something by heart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appropriate, take, or choose something for oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction with لنفسه expresses retaining something for one's own use or possession.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become angry or indignant, especially because of foul or offensive speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the intransitive anger development of the Form VIII verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person possessing strong retention in the mind or memory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is a lexical designation for a man of much memorizing or retention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Defense of persons or things regarded as sacred, inviolable, honorable, or deserving protection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the honor-defense obligation itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Indignation or anger caused by injury to something one is bound to honor or defend, by harm to a protected relation, or by breach of a covenant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the emotional result of threatened honor or violated protective obligation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An inscribed amulet or charm hung on a child to ward off the evil eye or similar harm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized concrete noun use, not the general meaning of preservation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A memorizer or person with a retentive faculty who seldom forgets what has been learned by heart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized nominal use belongs to the cognitive-retention branch rather than the guardian sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A keeper of a secret or oath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may describe a person who maintains confidential information or observes an oath; the Quranic oath command is separately represented under the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A divine preserver from whose preservation nothing is excluded, including the deeds of creatures and the heavens and earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a theological epithet describing comprehensive preservation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose sleep does not overcome the eye, so that the eye remains watchful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression based on the eye's guarding the person while wakefulness is maintained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A distinct and direct road that remains traceable rather than disappearing from view.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative or dialectal extension of continuity and keeping to a clear course.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Things or protected persons whose injury provokes a man's anger and protective response, especially women or dependents under his protection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural noun can refer both to provoking circumstances and to the persons whose protection occasions the anger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young child, used as a term of good omen in the dialect of Mecca.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized substantivized use derived from the idea of being kept or protected.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something retained in the mind or memory and known or learned by heart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This passive-participial use applies to memorized material rather than to something physically guarded.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Core preservation, attentiveness, memory, secrecy, restraint, and regard branches are represented.
Quranic oath-observance and restraint construction represented.
Honor-defense and resulting honor-conscious stance represented.
Persistent observance, including prayer observance, represented under the Quranic Form III sense.
Causation of anger by offensive speech represented.
Transitive carefulness about an affair is covered by the broader caution meaning.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the Form I entry.
Appropriation or retention for oneself represented.
Charging someone to preserve and entrusting something for safekeeping are both represented.
Inflectional identification of the Form I verbal noun.
Specialized noun for a person with strong memory represented.
Guardian, memory, secrecy/oath, divine-preserver, and sleepless-watch meanings are represented.
Protected women and dependents are covered by the same provoking/protected-persons meaning.

cautions: The Quranic use of حَفِيظٌ in 50:4 is explicitly open to both an active interpretation, “preserving or retaining,” and a passive interpretation, “preserved”; both are represented separately.
The Form X public headword is normalized to the active perfect اِسْتَحْفَظَ, while the supplied Quran occurrence is passive and is interpreted through its passive construction.
